title: Some Blessed Day
firstLine: Some day in Jesus' name, The sun will shine again,

lines: Some day in Jesus' name, The sun will shine again,
Hope on, nor hope in vain, 'Twill come some day!
Grief then shall change to joy, God's will our pow'rs employ,
And sin no more destroy, Some blessed day!
Some day we'll need no sun, 'Twill mean that heav'n's begun,
With all earth's battles won, When dawns that day!
With shadows past, and woe, All dark things clearer grow,
And we great joy shall know Some blessed day!
Perhaps it soon may be That shadows dark shall flee,
And from earth's fetters free, We'll greet that day!
Thro' grace from heaven's throne, Not merit of our own,
We'll find a better home Some blessed day!
